name: staging-feedback-intake
description: Twice-daily sweep of Slack and Gmail for client feedback on their Hydra dev/staging site, scoped to the running Account Manager's own projects. Drafts a client reply with clarifying questions, logs the request on the Hydra Production Tracker with the Viber @-mentioned, and DMs the Viber a prompt-ready brief. Client messages are drafts only — the operator sends them. Needs the Slack, Asana and Gmail connectors.
